shopPages.productNote.title: Delivery and returns
shopPages.delivery.title: Delivery and payment
shopPages.delivery.description: How we deliver orders, what delivery costs and how to pay.
shopPages.delivery.summary: Delivery across Ukraine in 1–3 days after dispatch. Returns within 14 days.
shopPages.delivery.methods.title: Delivery methods
shopPages.delivery.methods.caption: Delivery methods, times and costs
shopPages.delivery.methods.note: You see the exact delivery cost to your address at checkout, before you confirm the order.
shopPages.delivery.payment.title: Payment
shopPages.delivery.payment.body:
Once you have placed your order, you can pay for it by card online on the order page. There are no other payment methods yet. Prices on the site are in hryvnias.

If a payment fails, try again on the order page or write to us.
shopPages.delivery.tracking.title: Tracking
shopPages.delivery.tracking.body: When your order is dispatched, its tracking number appears on the order page. You get the link to that page when you place the order; with an account, the order is also under “My orders”.
shopPages.returns.title: Returns and exchanges
shopPages.returns.description: How to return or exchange an item and when you get your money back.
shopPages.returns.conditions.title: Conditions
shopPages.returns.conditions.body:
You can return or exchange an item of proper quality within 14 days of receiving it, if it has not been used and keeps its look, labels and packaging.

If an item is faulty, write to us: we offer an exchange, a repair or a refund.
shopPages.returns.how.title: How to return
shopPages.returns.how.body:
Write to us or call us with your order number. We confirm the return and tell you where to send the item.

We refund the way you paid, within a few days of receiving and checking the item.
shopPages.returns.exceptions.title: What cannot be returned
shopPages.returns.exceptions.body: Digital goods that have already been downloaded, and items made to your order.
shopPages.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
shopPages.faq.description: Answers to the questions we are asked most often.
shopPages.faq.order.question: How do I place an order?
shopPages.faq.order.answer: Add products to the cart, go to checkout, enter your contact and delivery details and confirm the order. You do not need an account.
shopPages.faq.status.question: Where can I see my order status?
shopPages.faq.status.answer: On the order page: you get its link when you place the order. If you ordered with an account, the order is also under “My orders”.
shopPages.faq.payment.question: How do I pay for my order?
shopPages.faq.payment.answer: By card online on the order page. More on the “Delivery and payment” page.
shopPages.faq.delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
shopPages.faq.delivery.answer: Usually 1–3 days after dispatch. The methods and costs for your address are shown at checkout.
shopPages.faq.cancel.question: Can I cancel my order?
shopPages.faq.cancel.answer: You can cancel an unpaid order on the order page. If you have already paid but the order has not been dispatched yet, write to us.
shopPages.faq.returns.question: How do I return an item?
shopPages.faq.returns.answer: Within 14 days of receiving it, if it has not been used. All conditions are on the “Returns and exchanges” page.
shopPages.about.title: About us
shopPages.about.description: Who we are and how we work.
shopPages.about.who.title: Who we are
shopPages.about.who.body:
We are a small online shop: we sell clothing, tools and digital goods and deliver them across Ukraine.

We describe every product so that you know what you get: the photos, details and stock on the site match what is in our warehouse.
shopPages.about.promise.title: What matters to us
shopPages.about.promise.body: Clear prices without hidden extras, quick answers to your questions and fair return conditions.
shopPages.sizeGuide.title: Size guide
shopPages.sizeGuide.description: How to choose your clothing size.
shopPages.sizeGuide.chart.title: Clothing sizes
shopPages.sizeGuide.chart.caption: Clothing sizes and body measurements in centimetres
shopPages.sizeGuide.chart.note: If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one.
shopPages.sizeGuide.measure.title: How to measure
shopPages.sizeGuide.measure.body:
Chest: around the fullest part of the chest, keeping the tape level.

Waist: around the narrowest part, without pulling the tape tight.
shopPages.contacts.title: Contacts
shopPages.contacts.description: How to reach us and when we answer.
shopPages.contacts.details.title: Get in touch
shopPages.contacts.answers.title: When we answer
shopPages.contacts.answers.body: We answer calls, emails and messages during working hours, usually within one working day. Give your order number and we can help faster.
